newsitem.title: CHINA: China Everbright Corp opens Shanghai branch.
newsitem.headline: China Everbright Corp opens Shanghai branch.

text.p: China Everbright (Group) Corp has opened a branch in Shanghai where its investments already total close to 10 billion yuan ($1.2 billion), the Liberation Daily said on Sunday.
Everbright, one of China's major state investment vehicles, owns a wide range of assets, including a 51 percent stake in China's first joint stock bank, the China Everbright Bank.
The group's Shanghai headquarters was formally opened on Saturday in one of the old colonial trading houses on the Bund riverfront recently occupied by the Everbright Bank, the newspaper said.
